title: Language Models Show Conformity Bias in RAG: When the Majority Endorses a Poisoned Claim
abstract: arXiv:2610.41012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can expose language models to misleading evidence in retrieved documents. We investigate whether increasing the number of mutually agreeing poisoned documents affects a model's ability to detect misinformation. We evaluate 200 randomly selected questions from SciFact (random seed 38), comparing contexts with one poisoned and six healthy documents against contexts with six mutually agreeing poisoned documents and one healthy document. For Gemma-3-12b, poison-detection rates decrease from 25% (50/200) in the minority condition to 10% (20/200) in the majority condition. Among the 38 questions with different outcomes across conditions, 34 change from detected to undetected, while only four change in the opposite direction (exact McNemar test, p = 6.04e-7). This pattern is consistent with a conformity-like response to a majority of mutually agreeing poisoned documents. Our results provide initial evidence

translated_title: 语言模型在检索增强生成（RAG）中表现出从众偏差：当多数文档支持被投毒的论断时
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）可能使语言模型接触到检索文档中具有误导性的证据。我们研究了相互一致的投毒文档数量增加是否会影响模型检测错误信息的能力。我们从SciFact数据集中随机选取200个问题（随机种子38）进行评估，将包含一篇投毒文档和六篇健康文档的上下文，与包含六篇相互一致的投毒文档和一篇健康文档的上下文进行对比。对于Gemma-3-12b模型，投毒检测率从少数条件下的25%（50/200）下降至多数条件下的10%（20/200）。在两种条件下结果不同的38个问题中，有34个从“被检测出”变为“未被检测出”，仅有4个朝相反方向变化（精确McNemar检验，p = 6.04e-7）。这一模式与语言模型面对多数相互一致的投毒文档时产生的类从众式反应一致。我们的结果提供了初步证据……
tldr: 本研究发现当RAG检索上下文中多数相互一致的投毒文档共同支持错误信息时，语言模型的投毒检测率从25%显著降至10%，揭示了语言模型存在类似社会从众心理的从众偏差，使其更容易被多数派的投毒信息误导。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a conformity bias in language models under RAG: when six mutually agreeing poisoned documents outnumber healthy ones, poison-detection rates drop significantly from 25% to 10%, showing that majority-endorsed misinformation substantially undermines models' ability to detect poisoned claims.
